import json,urllib.request,urllib.error,subprocess
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/console/"
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self,req,fp,code,msg,headers,newurl):return None
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect())
def get(path):
    req=urllib.request.Request(root+path,headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-MFA-Login-Smoke","Cache-Control":"no-cache"})
    try:
        with opener.open(req,timeout=10) as r:return r.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:return e.code
login=get("login")
setup=get("mfa/setup")
qr=get("assets/js/mfa-qr.js")
assert login==200 and setup in (302,303) and qr==200,(login,setup,qr)
php="""require '/home/appontrack/public_html/saas/console/_core/Bootstrap.php';require '/home/appontrack/public_html/saas/console/_core/AdminMfa.php';init_schema();$uid=(int)one("SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN memberships m ON m.user_id=u.id JOIN accounts a ON a.id=m.account_id WHERE a.kind='platform' AND m.role='owner' LIMIT 1")['id'];echo json_encode(['privileged'=>mfa_privileged($uid),'gate_required'=>mfa_gate_required($uid),'enrolled_records'=>(int)one('SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM admin_mfa')['n']]);"""
p=subprocess.run(["/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php","-r",php],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8,check=True)
data=json.loads(p.stdout)
assert data["privileged"]==True and data["gate_required"]==False and data["enrolled_records"]==0,data
print(json.dumps({"result":"PUBLIC_MFA_LOGIN_FIXED","login_http":login,"unenrolled_setup_redirect_http":setup,"qr_generator_http":qr,"admin_mfa_gate_required":data["gate_required"],"enrolled_records":data["enrolled_records"],"secrets_read":False,"deployed_source":"9df8524f6aac"}))
